name: 95382 · Turlock, CA
findings: ZIP 95382 (Turlock) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95382 (Turlock) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95382 (Turlock) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).
